articles.title: Modi, Xi to Hold First Bilateral on Indian Soil Since 2020 Galwan Clash
articles.summary: As leaders gather at Bharat Mandapam for the September 12-13 BRICS summit, Prime Minister Modi and Chinese President Xi Jinping are set for their first bilateral talks on Indian soil since the 2020 Galwan Valley clash. Xi's visit is also his first to India in seven years. Modi is also expected to hold separate talks with Russian President Vladimir Putin during the summit.

articles.title: Supreme Court Asks CBSE to Consider Relief From Three-Language Rule for Class 6
articles.summary: The Supreme Court asked the CBSE to examine relief for current Class 6 students from the contested three-language formula this academic year, while the broader challenge continues on September 17. Chief Justice Surya Kant's bench asked the Solicitor General to report on feasible accommodations. The policy has drawn strong opposition in several southern states.

articles.title: AAP Alleges Fraud as Raghav Chadha's Name Appears on Delhi Voter Rolls
articles.summary: AAP accused the Election Commission of irregularly inserting BJP MP Raghav Chadha into Delhi's electoral roll, noting his entry wasn't in the draft list released weeks earlier. Delhi's CEO said the addition followed the standard Form 6 process used for roughly 700 applicants. Chadha, who quit AAP for the BJP in April, dismissed it as a "bitter ex" targeting him.

articles.title: 22 BRS MLAs, Including KTR, Suspended From Telangana Assembly
articles.summary: The Telangana Assembly Speaker suspended 22 BRS MLAs, including working president KT Rama Rao, after they disrupted proceedings when their adjournment motion was denied priority. The MLAs were protesting alleged police excesses against party workers and threats to former CM K. Chandrashekar Rao. BRS called it a bid to silence the opposition; the government cited House rules.

articles.title: Rajasthan Votes in First Phase of Urban Local Body Elections
articles.summary: Voting began in the first phase of Rajasthan's urban local body polls, covering 162 bodies, 5,393 wards and over 20,000 candidates across four municipal corporations and 158 smaller bodies. Both the BJP and Congress see the results as an early test of urban support ahead of 2028 assembly polls. Phase two votes September 11; counting is September 14.

articles.title: Tamil Nadu's Ruling Coalition Formally Names Itself 'Secular Social Justice Victory Alliance'
articles.summary: Tamil Nadu's ruling five-party coalition — TVK, Congress, VCK, MDMK and IUML — named itself the Secular Social Justice Victory Alliance, with a common minimum programme and steering committee planned. CPI and CPI(M) declined membership, offering outside support instead. Cracks have surfaced over 2029, with some Congress leaders pushing Rahul Gandhi's prime ministerial claim.

articles.title: India to Host Expanded BRICS Summit With Putin, Xi Expected
articles.summary: India will host an expanded 11-nation BRICS summit in New Delhi on September 12-13, with Russian President Vladimir Putin confirmed and Chinese President Xi Jinping expected. The bloc, now spanning Asia, Africa and the Middle East, will discuss local-currency trade, supply-chain security and reform of the UN Security Council and IMF.

articles.title: ECI Announces Bypolls in Four States, Voting on October 6
articles.summary: The Election Commission announced bypolls for six seats in Tamil Nadu, West Bengal, Assam and Puducherry, triggered by resignations including West Bengal's Suvendu Adhikari and Puducherry's N. Rangasamy. Nominations open September 9 and close September 16, with polling on October 6 and counting on October 9.

articles.title: 57th GST Council to Meet September 12, Registration Reform on Agenda
articles.summary: The GST Council will meet for the 57th time on September 12 in New Delhi, its first sitting in a year, chaired by Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman. The agenda includes simplifying registration for larger businesses and easing provisional refund rules based on risk assessment. The last meeting had consolidated GST into a two-rate structure of 5% and 18%.

articles.title: Supreme Court Quashes NEET-UG Protest FIRs, Orders Compensation Policy
articles.summary: A three-judge bench led by Chief Justice Surya Kant quashed FIRs from July's NEET-UG protests, invoking Article 142 to protect "bonafide" peaceful demonstrators, in Shailendra Mani Tripathi v. Union of India. Police may still pursue 2,873 people flagged with serious criminal records. The Centre must frame a compensation policy within 90 days for bereaved families.

articles.title: PM Modi Reviews Ministers' Performance Ahead of Likely Cabinet Reshuffle
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi held performance-review meetings with Ministers of State at Sewa Tirth, following sessions with senior Cabinet colleagues, seen as preparation for a possible council of ministers reshuffle. A special Parliament session is expected in the third week of September. No reshuffle date has been confirmed.

articles.title: Karnataka's Electoral Roll Revision Enters Claims and Objections Window
articles.summary: Karnataka's electoral roll revision entered its claims-and-objections window, open until September 23, after draft rolls were published on August 24 with October 1 as the qualifying date. The exercise follows opposition criticism of similar SIR drives elsewhere over fears of wrongful deletions. The final roll is due October 27.

articles.title: Monsoon Session Sees Passage of Three Key Bills
articles.summary: Parliament wrapped up its monsoon session with the passage of the Digital India Bill, an amendment to the Representation of the People Act, and a new framework for federal-state fiscal transfers. The Digital India Bill introduces data-protection duties for platforms and creates a new grievance-redressal authority. The RP Act amendment tightens disclosure rules for candidates.

articles.title: Supreme Court Reaffirms Basic Structure Doctrine
articles.summary: In a five-judge constitution bench ruling, the Supreme Court reaffirmed that Parliament cannot amend the basic structure of the Constitution. The judgment strikes down an amendment that would have curtailed judicial review of certain executive orders. The bench held that judicial review is itself a part of the basic structure.

articles.title: ECI Issues New Guidelines for Social Media Campaigns
articles.summary: The Election Commission of India has released updated guidelines for political campaigning on social media platforms. All political ads must now carry clear disclaimers identifying the sponsor and funding source. AI-generated content depicting real politicians must carry a visible disclosure.

articles.title: Uttarakhand's UCC Enters Second Year of Implementation
articles.summary: Uttarakhand's Uniform Civil Code completed one year of implementation this week. The state government released data showing over 12,000 marriage registrations and 800 live-in relationship declarations under the new law. A constitutional challenge is pending before the Uttarakhand High Court.

articles.title: Panel Set Up to Review 73rd Amendment Implementation
articles.summary: A parliamentary standing committee has been set up to review the working of the 73rd Constitutional Amendment, which created the Panchayati Raj system in 1992. The panel will examine fiscal devolution to panchayats, functional autonomy, and the reservation of seats for women and marginalised communities.
